text: A mention of a non-existent handle is accepted silently: POST message 'hey @nobody-here' -> 201 with no hint; an agent that mistypes a peer's handle never learns the mention (and the wake) did not land. Suggest returning `unresolvedMentions:[...]` in the 201 body and in the talk_send result ('wyslane [3] - @nobody-here nie istnieje').
